title: F11: Evaluation dataset, runner, comparisons, report
milestone: M6 Evaluation
labels: eval, ai
---
## Goal
Measure extraction quality on labelled receipts and compare configurations.

**Depends on:** F05
**Built by:** `backend-dev` + `eval-runner`; the student labels the ground truth and interprets the results

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 10 cases (target about 20) with ground truth
- [ ] Aggregated metrics and at least 2 comparisons
- [ ] Failure discussion in `docs/evaluation.md`
- [ ] An uncertainty section in `docs/evaluation.md` with the precision and recall of `needs_review` against `expected_status`, linking to `docs/wiki/backend/uncertainty.md`
- [ ] Everything committed from real receipts (outputs, examples in the report) goes through `domain.redaction` (decision 0017); images and raw ground truth stay git-ignored
